music.prompt: Calm, warm and understated instrumental for a thoughtful film about a teacher at work: gentle felt piano and soft plucked textures (kalimba, muted nylon guitar) over a light, steady soft pulse, curious and focused, about 96 bpm, intimate and close. Starts quiet and simple from the first second. Around 8 seconds a small, gentle lift: a soft round bass note and a light brushed rhythm join, the plucks get a little brighter. Then it stays even and light and ends softly on a resolved chord. No big swells, no epic hits, no risers, no tension builds, no drops, no cinematic drums.
